title: Implementing Brain Health PRO Across Diverse Settings: A Multi-Site Implementation Study
official: Implementing Brain Health PRO - A Dementia Risk Reduction Program - Across Diverse Settings, With Emphasis on Rural and Underserved Communities: Phase 2
summary: Brain Health PRO (BHPRO) is a 6-month, web-based dementia-risk-reduction program targeting modifiable risk factors for cognitive decline. This 12-months, multi-site, single-arm, mixed-methods implementation study (Hybrid Type III design) evaluates the real-world adoption, sustainability, and reach of BHPRO across 10-14 partner sites in Canada, spanning seven provinces, including community organizations, clinics, and a public-health agency, with emphasis on rural and underserved communities. Tailored implementation toolkits (BHPRO-ITs), co-developed during Phase 1 using the ERIC taxonomy, are deployed at each site. Implementation outcomes (adoption, sustainability, reach, appropriateness, feasibility) are assessed at provider and organizational levels via online questionnaires and twice-monthly champion meetings. Effectiveness outcomes (dementia literacy, self-efficacy, modifiable risk factor composite, cognition) are collected from end users (adults aged 50+, at risk of dementia) at baseline, 3 months, post-program (6 months), and follow-up (12 months).
